sn36.6:1.25: The ablative _dukkhasmā_ here is explained by the commentary as taking an instrumental sense, like the preceding terms.
sn36.6:4.1: Text seems to require an implicit “mental” (supplied by Bodhi and Ṭhānissaro) or an idiomatic sense of _vedayati_ as “affected” (Woodward). I follow the latter.
